recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast image featuring a black silhouette of a figure standing atop a large black five-pointed star, set against a textured golden background. The figure is depicted in a dynamic pose with one arm raised, pointing upwards. Text elements are integrated into the design, primarily within the black star and at the bottom of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: The black silhouette of the figure is centrally positioned and stands directly on the top point of the black star.
The large black star acts as a strong visual anchor and a base for the figure, contrasting sharply with the golden background.
The textured golden background provides a rich, historical, and somewhat aged feel, serving as the primary color field.
Text elements are strategically placed within the black star and at the bottom, maintaining readability against the dark background or in a clear area.
coreInvariants: The silhouette of the figure must be black and positioned atop a black star.
The star must be a prominent five-pointed shape, also in black.
The background must be a textured golden color, suggesting age or prestige.
The overall composition must maintain a high contrast between the black elements and the golden background.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The silhouette figure is positioned centrally in the upper half of the image, scaled to be dominant but leaving ample space for the star and background. Its feet are precisely at the apex of the star.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large black five-pointed star serves as the primary visual anchor, grounding the composition and providing a strong base for the figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The raised arm of the figure directs the eye upwards, while the overall composition leads the eye from the figure down to the star and then to the text elements within and below it.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The golden textured background functions as significant negative space around the black silhouette and star, allowing them to stand out prominently. The black star itself contains negative space around the main title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The golden textured background serves as the dominant color, providing warmth and a sense of historical grandeur.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black is the primary contrast color, used for the silhouette, star, and most text, creating strong visual separation and impact.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: No distinct accent color is present; the composition relies on the dominant gold and contrasting black.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The golden background has moderate saturation and a medium-to-light value, while the black elements are fully saturated and have a very dark value, creating a high-contrast relationship.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black and shades of gold/brown.
No bright or highly saturated colors outside of the gold spectrum.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The main title uses a serif typeface with moderate stroke contrast and a relatively tall x-height. The subtitle and bottom text use sans-serif typefaces.
letterConstructionRules: Serif typeface for the main title, with clear, sharp serifs.
Sans-serif typeface for supporting text, with consistent stroke width and open counters.

composition.position: horizontally centered within the black star, below the figure
composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the black star, acting as a label for the central motif

composition.position: horizontally centered, directly below the main title, within the black star
composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the black star, providing context for the main title

composition.position: horizontally centered at the very bottom of the image, outside the star
composition.relationshipToImage: positioned against the golden background, providing additional information

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A classic pairing of a strong, elegant serif for the main title with clean, legible sans-serifs for supporting information, ensuring hierarchy and readability.
graphicDevices: The Parental Advisory Explicit Content label is a standard graphic device, positioned in the bottom right corner.

preserve: The high contrast between text and background.
The all-caps styling for all text roles.
The relative scale and positioning of text elements.
avoid: Low contrast text against the background.
Mixed case for any of the text roles.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic, elegant serif style with strong capitals and moderate contrast.
Provides a clean, all-caps sans-serif with good legibility and a modern feel, suitable for supporting text.
A versatile sans-serif with good readability in all caps, offering a similar clean and open character to the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured golden background with subtle variations in tone and light, suggesting an aged or metallic surface. On top of this, place a large, solid black five-pointed star, centered horizontally and extending from the bottom edge upwards, with its top point reaching approximately two-thirds up the canvas. Position a black silhouette of a figure in a dynamic pose (one arm raised, pointing upwards) standing precisely on the top point of the black star.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main title 'HAMILTON' in a white, all-caps serif font (e.g., Trajan Pro) centered within the black star, below the figure. Below this, add the subtitle 'AN AMERICAN MUSICAL' in a smaller, white, all-caps, loosely tracked sans-serif font (e.g., Bebas Neue or Montserrat). At the very bottom of the image, centered, add 'ORIGINAL BROADWAY CAST RECORDING' in a small, white, all-caps sans-serif font. In the bottom right corner, place a standard 'Parental Advisory Explicit Content' graphic.

verificationChecks: Is the main title clearly legible against the black star?
Are the subtitle and caption distinct from the main title in scale and weight?
Is the overall text hierarchy maintained?
Does the text treatment (color, case) match the original?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade and texture of gold for the background.
Exact pose of the silhouette figure, as long as it maintains a dynamic, upward-pointing gesture.
Dimensions and aspect ratio of the star, as long as it remains a prominent five-pointed shape.
Specific serif and sans-serif fonts used, provided they adhere to the anatomical and typesetting rules.
mustRedesign: Any deviation from the high-contrast black and gold color scheme.
Introduction of additional colors or complex patterns.
Changing the fundamental composition of the figure on the star.
Using script or highly decorative fonts for any text role.

mustAchieve: Clear readability of all text elements.
A sense of drama and historical significance.

postGenerationChecks: Verify that the silhouette is sharp and distinct from the background.
Ensure the star is perfectly symmetrical and its edges are clean.
Check that the golden background has a rich, varied texture.
Confirm all text is white, all-caps, and correctly positioned.
Ensure the Parental Advisory label is present and correctly placed.
Assess the overall balance and visual impact of the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate the iconic black silhouette of a figure standing on a black five-pointed star against a textured golden background. Integrate white, all-caps serif and sans-serif typography for hierarchical text elements, maintaining high contrast and a dramatic, historical aesthetic.
